learning_outcomes.title: Dilations and reflections of quadratics
learning_outcomes.statement: Write quadratics in vertex form and transform their graphs.
learning_outcomes.rule_summary: A negative outside coefficient reflects across the x-axis; |a|>1 stretches vertically. Simplify an inside coefficient before comparing.
